question: 2026 年 1–3 月每个月的销售额分别是多少？三个月合计多少？

read_only_sql_calls.sql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS stat_month,
       SUM(pay_amount) AS sales_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS completed_order_cnt
FROM orders
WHERE status = '已完成'
  AND order_date >= '2026-01-01'
  AND order_date < '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY stat_month
ORDER BY stat_month

question: 云桥店 2026 年 1–3 月的销售额是多少？

read_only_sql_calls.sql: SELECT store_id, store_name, city, opened_on FROM stores ORDER BY store_id
read_only_sql_calls.description: 核对门店维度表中云桥店编号

read_only_sql_calls.sql:
SELECT o.store_id,
       SUM(o.pay_amount) AS sales_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS completed_order_cnt
FROM orders AS o
JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.status = '已完成'
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < '2026-04-01'
  AND s.store_id = 'S03'
GROUP BY o.store_id
read_only_sql_calls.description: 统计云桥店 2026 年 1-3 月销售额合计

read_only_sql_calls.sql:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS stat_month,
       SUM(o.pay_amount) AS sales_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS completed_order_cnt
FROM orders AS o
JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.status = '已完成'
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < '2026-04-01'
  AND s.store_id = 'S03'
GROUP BY stat_month
ORDER BY stat_month
read_only_sql_calls.description: 按月拆分云桥店 2026 年 1-3 月销售额

       s.store_name,
       SUM(o.pay_amount) AS sales_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt

WHERE o.status = '已完成'
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < '2026-04-01'
